tests.title: The delivered h5ad opens on anndata 0.10 as well as 0.12.
tests.why: The frozen source file used nullable-string encoding that anndata 0.10 cannot read.

tests.title: Shape, raw integer counts, and X = log1p of counts-per-10k, checked on real cells.
tests.detail: 209,639 x 32,031; counts dtype uint16; max |X - log1p(CP10k)| = 4.0e-07 on 300 cells

tests.title: genes.tsv lists the matrix's genes in the matrix's order, with unique ids.
tests.detail: 32,031 rows; order matches: True; Ensembl ids match: True; unique Ensembl True, unique marker names True

tests.title: Every marker in every list names exactly one gene in the matrix, and its Ensembl twin agrees.
tests.detail: 15,642 marker entries; 0 unresolved or mismatched; 0 misaligned lists

tests.title: C001-C112 in both files, same cell counts, every cluster at or above the 50-cell floor.
tests.detail: ids C001-C112 in both: True; n_cells agree: True; smallest cluster 55 cells

tests.title: Lists hold at most 50 genes; n_cells_used is n_cells capped at 5,000 (the page says eleven are capped).
tests.detail: longest list 50; empty lists {'top_50_markers': 0, 'bottom_50_markers': 1, 'family_50_markers': 0}; capped clusters 11; cap rule holds: True

tests.title: The menu hash recomputes to dec9f728, ids are unique, and every parent resolves.
tests.detail: hash dec9f7289d7c…; 3,107 terms, 3,107 unique; 0 dangling parents; kinds {'structure': 2457, 'cell': 650}

tests.title: Nothing held back reaches Commit: no label columns, no published markers, no excluded-cluster names.
tests.detail: obs label-like columns: 0; zscape_published_markers shipped: False; uns dropped_clusters: False; excluded names found in delivered text: 0

tests.title: The worked example on /commit (ZFA:0000516) is on the menu and is not a key answer or near one.
tests.why: The page promises the example cannot hint at any scored cluster.
tests.detail: on menu: True; clusters whose answer is the example or one of its ancestors: 0

tests.title: The source key still has the checksum recorded at ingest.
112 rows, one per delivered cluster, with matching cell counts.
tests.detail: 112 rows; ids and n_cells match the matrix: True

tests.title: Every primary, alternative and axis term validates against the menu; blanks are explicit.
tests.detail: 118 distinct key terms, 0 off-menu; 0 blank cells; NO_ZFA_TERM consistent: True

tests.title: Identity terms are cell types and anatomy terms are structures.
tests.why: The page says the two axes draw from different branches; scoring relies on it.
tests.detail: identity terms that are not cell types: 0; anatomy terms that are cell types: 1

tests.title: No accepted alternative equals the primary or is an ancestor of it.
tests.detail: 6 multi-answer clusters, 6 alternatives, 0 that reward retreat

tests.title: Every primary answer is a structure or cell ZFA says exists at 48 hpf (where ZFA records a stage window).
tests.detail: inside window 54, no stage data 56, outside the 48 hpf window 2 — curator review needed (ids in the local pytest log)

tests.title: Page: evidence_ambiguous is true on 31 of the 112 clusters.
Page: granularity exact 71 / broader 24 / narrower 16; agreement unanimous on roughly 80 clusters.
tests.detail: granularity {'exact': 71, 'broader': 24, 'narrower': 16, 'none': 1}; unanimous identity 80, anatomy 82

tests.title: Page: the key leaves the cell-type axis empty on 7 clusters and the anatomical axis on 2.
tests.detail: identity empty 7, anatomy empty 2

tests.title: Page: the two axes differ on 111 of the 112 clusters.
tests.detail: 111/112 differ

tests.title: Page: the committed pick is usually one of the two axis terms, and a third term on 7 clusters.
tests.why: (Corrected 2026-09-18: the page used to say the pick is never a third opinion.)
tests.detail: 7 clusters whose committed pick is neither axis term

tests.title: Page: roughly one menu term in five names a cell type.
The headline numbers the pages render (clusters, cells, genes, terms, hash) match the delivered files.
Submitting the key's own primaries scores 112 full and 112 strict exact.
tests.detail: full 112/112, half 0, zero 0; strict exact 112/112

tests.title: Every menu term gets exactly one outcome on every cluster — no crashes, no undefined cases.
tests.detail: 347,984 (term, cluster) pairs: {'zero': 347582, 'full': 188, 'half': 214}

tests.title: Answering the same very broad term everywhere earns no full credit and almost no half credit.
tests.why: Reading 'the region containing it' as any ontology ancestor pays half on all 81 cell-type clusters for 'whole organism'; the reference scorer only accepts the key's anatomy term or one level above it.
tests.detail: 84 broad terms (depth <= 2) tried; best of them: full 0/112, half 8, zero 104; strict exact 0/112 = 3.6% of the credit

tests.title: Where the key names a region, some menu cell type sits inside it (the page's 'more precise' full credit).
tests.detail: 11/31 region-answered clusters have any menu cell type inside them (ZFA rarely links cell types to regions) — the clause is live for those only

tests.title: Retreating to a broader cell type should not score below retreating to the region.
tests.why: As written, a parent cell type scores zero while the region scores half.
tests.detail: 81 cell-type clusters where the parent cell type scores zero; on 78 of them the region scores half — decide whether that ordering is intended

tests.title: No single term answered for every cluster gets more than 20% full credit.
tests.detail: best constant answer: full 19/112, half 0, zero 93; strict exact 19/112 — the key leans heavily on one cell type

tests.title: A lookup script (top markers -> ZFIN 48 hpf expression -> most specific term, no model) stays under 50% full.
tests.why: This is also the draft 'number to beat': baselines/zfin_expression_baseline.py.
tests.detail: ZFIN lookup: full 17/112, half 13, zero 82; strict exact 16/112

tests.title: Delivered cells cannot be joined to ZSCAPE's public per-cell annotations.
tests.why: If they can, a solver reads the source label off GEO instead of the markers.
tests.detail: cell_id join: 100% of cells, 112/112 clusters map to one public label; with cell ids removed, (UMIs, genes) from the raw counts alone still recover 112/112

tests.title: Recovered public labels + plain name matching do not outscore the marker-based baseline.
tests.detail: shortcut (no biology, string match only): full 38/112, half 31, zero 43; strict exact 38/112 vs ZFIN lookup: full 17, half 13

tests.title: The scored set is large enough that hand-labelling is not the cheaper route (>= 500 clusters).
tests.detail: 112 clusters — a trained annotator can label these in days; only a held-out set seen at run time (with a time box) makes an agent the cheaper route

tests.title: The required citations and evidence statement have a format a validator enforces.
tests.why: A well-formed submission passes; broken ones (off-menu id, bad chain, uncited or unknown reference) fail.
tests.detail: well-formed submission: 0 problems; broken submissions caught 6/6 (all)
